newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 18.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- The Central Criminal Investigation Directorate has already seized more than 500 million forint of the 804 million which had been alleged irregular payment from the state privatisation agency APV to an advisor, Marta Tocsik.
- Participants of a conference of the Hungarian Energetics Society said Hungary should stop the privatisation of the energy sector.
- The Hungarian Parliament will vote about the friendship treaty with Romania only after the Romanian elections.
- It's very difficult to find a legal representative in Hungary in cases before the European Human Rights Court, a judge of the court told a conference.
